column3: Saori Route ・ Interrogated by Kuroneko
...The next day.
I went to school during the summer holidays to pass Kuroneko the information I got from Saori.
Here, the stuff you wanted.
...Certainly. I'll take it.
While using me as an excuse, what did you want to meet Saori for?
Pfft!!
U-Using you as an excuse?
Please don't act dumb.
You told me, right?
You said "I had something to ask Saori"...
Is, is that so...?
Yes. Senpai's speech and movements are carefully recorded in my deep consciousness, so there can be no mistakes.
Are you a recorder?!
Saori's our mutual friend. There shouldn't be any problems letting me know stuff regarding her, right?
Or could it be that it's something which cannot be told to me?
It's not... that I can't tell her. But telling her about the marriage interview here, is...
Saori didn't want me to tell anyone about her hospitalization. She probably doesn't want anyone know about her marriage interview either...
Saori doesn't want Kirino or Kuroneko to worry, which I can understand.
Come on, confess already.
It's nothing to confess; it's not really important...
If it's nothing important, then it should be okay to say it.
That's...
It's not good for your body to keep it bottled up.
...Let's see. For example...
I could borrow the power of the Denizens of Darkness, and send curses to you night after night...
A normal person would say "I'll give you missed calls every night" instead.
Like I said, it's really nothing important.
Who knows? If you're being that stubborn, I'll be more suspicious instead.
But, although she lost consciousness, she only stayed at the hospital for a few days before getting discharged.
...Lost consciousness?
What do you mean by lost consciousness?
Eh...
Well, you see...
Oh yes! I said "YOU LOST"! You know, like in the fighting games!
She got hospitalized, right?
Ooh?! I-If you come that close...
If you come that close? What are you saying?
If that's a problem, then quickly confess.
T-That's right! Saori was hospitalized!
But she got discharged after a few days; there's nothing particularly wrong!
I see...
She told you while keeping me in the dark.
...Could it be that I stepped on a land mine just now?
Kuroneko's look transmitted to me a fierce feeling as if it said "A secret between only you two, how shameless..."
I don't know whether it's just an illusion, but I feel the presence of a demon behind Kuroneko.
Actually, it's rather complicated.
How do I put it... It's a little hard to say...
...Why are you flustered?
It's not like I'm suspicious about the relationship between you two.
Saori probably told you:
Please keep this a secret from Kiririn-shi and Kuroneko-shi
and you were bearing that in mind, right?
...It's like Kuroneko could see through my heart.
Or is this the so-called "woman's intuition"?
Anyway, it's good that she understood the situation.
...I got it. I'll confess.
I nodded without hesitation. I didn't want to draw suspicion.
Hmph, as expected...
I admit defeat to your observant eye.
Isn't that obvious? That's the power only given to the chosen one.
Yes yes, just like that.
Never mind that, I have to return the favor for Saori's information.
If you meet her, could you pass this 【bracelet】 to her?
What's with this ominous bracelet...
It's an amulet. But, it's not just a simple amulet.
It's an amulet with the blessing of the Fallen Angel.
What Fallen Angel... The design looks like it has a curse instead...
By the way, do you always carry around this kind of stuff?
No.
I obtained the lucky amulet, but it's of a conflicting wavelength with me.
What do you mean?
I get dizzy when I wear it, and crows fly over me...
In the end, when my shoelace broke and I was troubled over it, your sister was like...
Are you so poor you can't get a proper shoelace? That's so sad lolololol
And that's how she made fun of me.
Then isn't it a cursed bracelet?!
...This is proof of its effectiveness.
More like proof of the opposite effect.
Unfortunately, it isn't of the same wavelength as me.
So it's wasted even if it has any effect?
...But, if a human who is different from me takes it, they might be able to conquer it.
That's why I want to pass it to her; to see whether she can do it.
You...
just want to experiment on Saori.
Oh? That's not true... Ufufu...
She might say that, but she laughed evilly.
Well, this is the usual for her, not having her actions and thoughts aligned.
She says that, but she's actually worried for Saori.
Even as she passed me the bracelet, her shoulder's awkwardly trembling.
Well then, I'm busy here...
If you meet her, please pass it on.
Hey, wait!
...What is it?
Can I ask one question?
If it's not on the same wavelength, then why were you hanging onto it?
...Isn't it obvious?
I was thinking of giving it to you.
...To me? Why?
...Please think about it yourself.
...Could it be.
It's her way of thanking me for getting the information for her?
There's actually no need for that; Kuroneko's really thoughtful.
